title: Portfolio Boarding | Loan Onboarding & Ledger Migration | Veteran Loan Servicing
description: How Veteran Loan Servicing boards a commercial loan portfolio: data intake, ledger migration, reconciliation, and go-live for CRE and business loan books.
lede: Boarding is where servicing risk is won or lost. We migrate loan data, payment schedules, and lender disbursement details into the platform and reconcile them before a single payment cycle runs.

howto.name: How a commercial loan portfolio is boarded
howto.description: The steps Veteran Loan Servicing follows to board a commercial loan portfolio and reconcile it before go-live.

steps.name: Portfolio review
steps.text: Review the existing portfolio, current servicing setup, and reporting requirements to scope the engagement.

steps.name: Data intake
steps.text: Collect loan-level balances, rates, payment schedules, borrower details, and lender disbursement instructions.

steps.name: Ledger mapping
steps.text: Map the intake data into the servicing ledger.

steps.name: Reconciliation
steps.text: Reconcile boarded records against your source of record and resolve any discrepancies.

steps.name: Go-live checkpoint
steps.text: Confirm balances, rates, and schedules tie out, then sign off and go live.

sections.heading: Process
paragraphs: Boarding runs as a defined sequence: portfolio review, data intake, mapping into the servicing ledger, reconciliation against your source of record, and a go-live checkpoint. Nothing goes live until balances, rates, and schedules tie out.
bullets: Loan, borrower, and lender data intake
Reconciliation against your source of record

sections.heading: Controls
paragraphs: Each boarded record is checked against the source file. Discrepancies are flagged and resolved before go-live rather than discovered mid-cycle. The boarding trail is retained so the migration itself is auditable.

sections.heading: Reporting
paragraphs: You receive a reconciliation summary at go-live: loans boarded, balances tied out, and any items held for clarification. From cycle one, boarded loans appear in standard portfolio reporting.

sections.heading: Benefits
paragraphs: A clean boarding reduces the disputes, misapplied payments, and reporting gaps that follow a rushed migration — and gives lenders and LPs confidence that the book was moved correctly.

faqs.q: What data do you need to board a portfolio?
faqs.a: Loan-level balances, rates, payment schedules, borrower contact details, and lender disbursement instructions. We confirm the exact intake format during portfolio review.
Every boarded record is reconciled against your source of record before go-live; discrepancies are resolved first, not after payments begin.
No. Veteran Loan Servicing boards commercial real estate and business/commercial loans only. We do not service consumer residential mortgages.
